revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Global CS: serialized synchronous authority operations own recursion and wait grants; shared memory and native process-birth identity travel to the authority. Existing yield9 retains its EIP/ESP frame and retries its generation-bound grant. Thread retirement routes through existing cs cleanup; transport disconnect removes its own owners/waiters. No guest callbacks are retained or dispatched by the new host calls.
